title: fix(console): doc-to-doc links carry the router basename (objectui#12686)
body:
Fixes #12686
Clause-②: no

## What

A link from one doc to another in a rendered doc body now carries the router basename. The portal rewrites a body's `[x](./other_doc.md)` reference to the docs route (`apps/console/src/pages/doc-links.ts`). It wrote `href="/docs/NAME"`. Under the `/_console` mount a plain left click worked, because `DocPage`'s click handler hands it to the router. A new tab, a middle-click or a copied link went to the server path `/docs/NAME` and answered 404 `ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND`.

## How

- `DocPage` reads `useHref('/docs')`, react-router's own href for the docs route: `/_console/docs` under the mount, `/docs` on a root mount. It passes that to `rewriteDocLinks`, whose `docsHref` parameter is now required. This is the source objectui#12233 used for record links. `documentHref` itself stays internal to app-shell, as its docstring requires, so nothing is exported and no second join is written.
- `onContentClick` intercepts a plain left click on an href under that docs href and calls `navigate` with the bare `/docs/...` router path. The router applies the basename itself.
- Unchanged: modifier and middle clicks (left to the browser), in-body fragment links and the ToC (still scrolled in JS because of the console's injected base element), external links, the docs routes and their permalink redirect.
- The destination stays the `/docs/NAME` permalink, which `DocsSlug` redirects to the book that claims the doc. The rewrite has no book context for the target.

## Evidence

Live, published 18.0.0-next.2 showcase served at `/_console` (screenshots and log on `claude/issue-12686-evidence`, `evidence/12686/`):

| | anchor href | open in new tab |
|---|---|---|
| before (vendored console) | `/docs/showcase_docs_guide` | 404 `ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND` |
| after (this branch's build) | `/_console/docs/showcase_docs_guide` | 200, lands at `/_console/docs/manual/showcase_docs_guide` |

A plain left click lands on `/_console/docs/manual/showcase_docs_guide` in both.

## Tests

`apps/console/src/pages/DocPage.docLinkBasename-12686.test.tsx` renders the body through the real `MarkdownRenderer`:

- Under basename `/_console`, the href equals what react-router's own `Link` renders for the same route.
- On a root mount the href stays `/docs/NAME`.
- A plain left click routes in the app.
- A modifier click is left to the browser.
- CONTROL: a fragment link still scrolls, and an external link is untouched.

`doc-links.test.ts` gains the prefixed case.

Ablation on `DocPage.tsx`, restored to HEAD blob `28c934b4` each time: fixing the href to `/docs` turns the oracle test red, navigating the full href turns the plain-click test red, and dropping the modifier guard turns the modifier test red.

At head `5de6926`: the 26 test files naming doc-links, DocPage or docs-portal pass (672 tests). The console type-check passes and covers both test files. The changeset and check scripts exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- Inside the app-scoped reader, a rewritten cross-reference still points at the global `/docs` tree. That is unchanged here, because the routes are outside this change.
- The showcase's `showcase_docs_guide.md` says the console rewrites a link "to /docs/showcase_index". That is still the router path; the rendered href now carries the basename.
